_comment: SINGLE SOURCE of the quality-evaluation vocabulary (rework R4). devai-core/build.rs turns this file into Rust code (crates/devai-core/src/vocab.rs includes it), and devai-ui/build.rs turns it into the frontend TS unions (crates/devai-ui/frontend/src/vocab.generated.ts). The seeded JSON schema (quality-report) takes its check-state enum and item-kind list from the generated Rust constants. Never hand-edit a generated surface; add the token HERE and rebuild.

check_states.doc: Mechanical probes all passed — the platform's own 1.0.
A mechanical probe failed: blocking, never a footnote.
Rubric-reviewed and scored by the auditor.
No score: probe did not run, evidence missing, or no auditor rating.
Left unsigned on purpose — the human's signature is the verdict.

item_kinds.doc: A gate probe failed — the verdict goes back.
A gate probe could not be performed.
The verdict's own threshold (S below theta) was not met.
Unperformed weight above the cap: the verdict cannot be complete.
A scored point below 1.0 — a nuance, ordered by lost points x weight.
Kept in force by a named ratified decision (names only).
Scored 1.0 without a decision link: the norm, not a finding (v1 forms listed it at importance 0; v2 counts it in the headline).
Scored state without a score — nothing to present but the fact.
A state this build does not recognise, shown with its raw token.
